If the existing stts sampleCount exceeds stbl->SampleSize->sampleCount (inconsistent state), the loop can write past the buffer. Also the repack loop reads DTSs[i+1] up to index sampleCount+1, which is within bounds only if sampNum reached sampleCount+1; if fewer samples were written, uninitialized/out-of-bounds reads occur.
